maddeler.e:
تعترضن (form VIII)
# تَعْتَرِضْنَ (taʕtariḍna) /taʕ.ta.ridˤ.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَرَضَ (iʕtaraḍa)
# تُعْتَرَضْنَ (tuʕtaraḍna) /tuʕ.ta.radˤ.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَرَضَ (iʕtaraḍa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
